description:
Cast Chromatic Orrery by paying its mana cost.
When Chromatic Orrery enters, Ultron triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Chromatic Orrery that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
Put the nontoken Chromatic Orrery into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
During your next turn, activate the Chromatic Orrery token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Chromatic Orrery token.
Repeat from step 4.
